findings.title: Invalidate connected calendars after deleting the cache
findings.body: The cache-deletion success handler only calls the optional onSuccess callback; it never invalidates connectedCalendars. SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper passes an optional external onChanged callback rather than refetching its query, and disables refetchOnWindowFocus. Consequently, when no refetching callback is provided, successful deletion leaves the old cache timestamp and Delete cached data action visible. Invalidate the connectedCalendars query on success, as the disconnect mutation already does.

findings.title: Set updatedAt explicitly instead of issuing an empty update
findings.body: Calling updateManyByCredentialId with an empty data object does not advance Prisma's @updatedAt field: Prisma leaves that timestamp unchanged for empty updates. Thus this new call does not record successful cache refreshes in SelectedCalendar.updatedAt as intended. Pass an explicit updatedAt timestamp, or remove this call if CalendarCache.updatedAt is the only refresh timestamp needed.
